messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — high rate of GPU OOMs in cluster `gpu-pool-3`. >50 container restarts in the last 10m. Affected model: redwood-13B-qa-v1. Prefill path appears implicated. Paging oncall.
mike_oncall: Oncall here, ack. Jumping in — handoff to eng-runtime and SRE.
laura_sre: I can see the restarts: `killed by signal 9` and repeated `CUDA out of memory` in pods inference-*-redwood-13B. Many have long `prefill` traces (~40k tokens). Node 3 shows flapping.
jin_runtime: Seeing large KV cache allocations during prefill. Probable long-context inputs + aggressive prefill. Starting live mitigations: 1) enable prefill trimming on routing, 2) lower per-request prefill token cap for this model, 3) route heavy requests to quantized fallback. Pushing policies now.
sara_ops: Applying rate limit on the endpoint: gateway rule -> max 30 reqs/s per tenant for redwood-13B-qa-v1. Also adding short circuit to reject >64k token prefill.
laura_sre: Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] inference: kernel_launch failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] inference: eviction unable to free required bytes
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] container terminated: exit code 137 (OOM)
```
We also see repeated `OOM` during `prefill/kvcache: allocate(236MB)` entries.
mike_oncall: Rolling traffic to warm fallback `redwood-13B-qa-q4` (quantized) for noisy tenants. Initiating canary swap (10% -> 50%).
jin_runtime: Hotpatch applied: set env `PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=4096` and enable `PREFILL_TRIM=true` for the redwood-13B-qa route. Commands I ran: 
```
# routing CLI (internal)
route update redwood-13B-qa set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=4096 PREFILL_TRIM=true
route promote redwood-13B-qa -> redwood-13B-qa-q4 --percent 10
```
sara_ops: Also evicting KV caches on the most affected pods to free memory: `kubectl exec -n inference pod/<pod> -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/evict-kvcache` (rolling)
emma_cs: Notifying impacted customer (cust-42) that we're experiencing transient errors for large-context requests. ETA for stabilization ~15-30m. No data loss, just request failures/latency. CS will post an update in 15m.
deploy-bot: Deployed config patch `prefill-trim-v1` to 6 nodes (gpu-pool-3).
laura_sre: After throttling + fallback, OOM rate dropped from 5/min to ~0.2/min. Node flapping stopped on node-3. Monitoring memory usage; some pods still near limit due to stuck KV entries.
mike_oncall: Good progress. Leaving oncall until stable and incident doc created. Next steps: 1) follow up with model onboarding team to add heavier quantized fallback, 2) add an automatic prefill token SLO check in routing, 3) run root-cause triage for why KV eviction didn't reclaim memory quickly.
emma_cs: Customer update posted: "We've mitigated the issue by throttling and routing to a fallback; you may see transient failures for long-context prompts. We'll follow up when fully resolved."
laura_sre: We'll keep the throttles for 30m, then ramp down if healthy. Creating incident ticket with logs and timeline.
mike_oncall: Confirmed stable at t+18m. Closing page but keeping watch. :white_check_mark:
